comment: Rules that no query can make the first match. Each entry was derived by reading RISCVLegalizerInfo.cpp and confirmed with --witness over all 8 configurations after the universe grew scalable-vector and s128 pairs. Rule indices are per configuration and shift when a builder omits a conditional clause; see docs/EVIDENCE-riscv.md.

gaps.follow_up: upstream redundant clause: the Zfa legal rules subsume this libcall when the feature is on, and it is the only fallback when it is off. Keep it out of the reachable-rule count; report upstream if a cleanup is wanted.
gaps.reason: shadowed in ristretto (the only Zfa configuration): legalFor(Zfa, {s32}) and legalFor(Zfa && D, {s64}) match the same result types earlier, so the libcallFor({s32, s64}) clause can never be the first match. In configurations without Zfa the clause is emitted as the first libcall rule and is witnessed.
